title: Request
body:
Syntax: mission request <d|c|b|a|s>

The legacy request <rank> alias still works. Only Mission-tagged mobs can be assigned. Each mob belongs to one rank for your current ninja level: D = <=5 levels above or weaker; C = 6-20 above; B = 21-40 above; A = 41-70 above; S = 71+ above. Targets automatically move to lower mission ranks as you level. Your chosen mission remains assigned when you gain levels. All hunts expire after 30 real-time minutes. Use mission info and mission fail.
